text: One Deluge condition. Two different answers.
Deluge has if, else if and else. The first true test wins; the rest are skipped.
So put the narrowest test first, or the later branches never run.
The trap: Zoho Creator works out OR before AND. Every other Zoho service works out AND first.
Put brackets round each group, and the test reads the same everywhere.
Empty is not one test. isNull, isBlank and isEmpty all give different answers.
For text, test isNull or isBlank. That covers null, empty text and spaces.
Need a default? Use ifNull. And there's no switch, so use a map lookup.
